verdict.rationale: First-party enterprise-readiness docs state that LlamaParse completed a SOC 2 Type II audit and offers a HIPAA-compliant pipeline with a BAA for Enterprise customers, which covers the compliance half of the story for contracts and medical records. Self-hosting/BYOC keeps data under customer control, but that is a deployment option, not a documented zero-retention policy for uploaded documents. missing for 10: an explicit zero-retention or no-storage policy for uploaded documents, details on retention periods or deletion, HIPAA availability beyond the Enterprise tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the compliance claims.

support.subject: As a data engineer, uploaded documents get zero-retention handling with SOC 2 and HIPAA options, so I can process contracts and medical records

citations.quote: LlamaParse Platform has completed a SOC 2 Type II audit. The report and subprocessor list are available through the Trust Center.
A HIPAA-compliant processing pipeline with a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) is available for Enterprise customers.
